summary: Crops an image by moving left, right, bottom, and top edges, discarding cropped pixels and reducing output resolution.

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Tile edge behavior: hold, zero, repeat, or mirror

common_gotchas: Crop reduces resolution; it is not just a matte or viewer crop.
Edge unit parameters are easy to misread when mixing pixel and fraction values.
Extend only matters when sampling outside the cropped tile edges.
Common output resolution or aspect overrides can hide the actual cropped dimensions.
key_concepts: Crop TOP defines new left, right, bottom, and top edges for the image.
Discarded pixels are removed, reducing the TOP resolution rather than only masking visibility.
Each crop edge has a companion unit parameter controlling how the edge value is interpreted.
Extend controls how sampling behaves at tile edges when outside data is needed.
Common TOP output resolution and aspect settings can still reshape the cropped result.
